parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Ishaan measures three bowls of soup. Bowl X reads 63 °C. Bowl Y reads 49 °C. Bowl Z reads 57 °C. Bowl Y looks the darkest.

part_answers.answer: On the same Celsius scale, the highest reading is hottest, so Bowl X at 63 °C is hotter than Y and Z. Colour of the soup does not decide hotness.

teacher.key_rationale: Higher temperature on the same scale means hotter. Bowl X at 63 °C is hottest. Darker appearance does not override the reading.
